news.title: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited Announces Resignation of Arijit Basu as Non- Executive Independent Director and Reconstitution of Board Committees, Effective March 17, 2026
news.body: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited at its board meeting held on March 17, 2026 announced the resignation of Mr. Arijit Basu (DIN: 06907779), Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company, with effect from March 17, 2026. He has directorships in IndusInd Bank Ltd. as Chairman and Independent Director. In view of the above Resignation, the Board approved reconstitution of following committees with effect from 17 March 2026: Nomination & Remuneration Committee, Risk Management Committee, Corporate Social Responsibility Committee.

news.title: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited (NSEI:CLEANMAX) entered into a share purchase agreement to acquire Kintech Solarbikaner Private Limited from Kintech Synergy Private Limited for an enterprise value of approximately INR 380 million.
news.body:
Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited (NSEI:CLEANMAX) entered into a share purchase agreement to acquire Kintech Solarbikaner Private Limited from Kintech Synergy Private Limited for an enterprise value of approximately INR 380 million on March 16, 2026. The transaction is for an enterprise value of INR 380.6 million. A cash consideration will be paid by Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited.

As of March 31, 2025, Kintech Solarbikaner Private Limited reported net liabilities of INR 0.08 million.

The expected completion of the transaction is March 31, 2026.

news.title: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited (NSEI:CLEANMAX) entered into an agreement to acquire an additional 26% stake in Clean Max Andes Private Limited from Astec LifeSciences Limited (NSEI:ASTEC) for INR 0.03 million.
news.body:
Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited (NSEI:CLEANMAX) entered into an agreement to acquire an additional 26% stake in Clean Max Andes Private Limited from Astec LifeSciences Limited (NSEI:ASTEC) for INR 0.03 million on March 9, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 0.03 million will be paid by Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited. As part of consideration, INR 0.03 million is paid towards common equity of Clean Max Andes Private Limited.

The expected completion of the transaction is March 10, 2026.
